title: Syrian-Style Smoky Lamb Kebabs
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish featuring smoky lamb kebabs infused with the warm spices of Syria.

ingredients.name: Smoky Syrian spice blend
ingredients.notes: Available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together smoky Syrian spice blend, olive oil, onion, garlic, lemon juice, salt, and black pepper.
Add lamb cubes to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Thread lamb cubes onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Grill kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until lamb reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let kebabs rest for 5 minutes before serving.
